en: The image depicts a black-and-white printed postcard featuring a detailed illustration and Latin text. The illustration shows a religious scene with two crowned figures holding staffs, seated on thrones with a cross and orb between them, likely representing Christian iconography. Below them are rows of kneeling figures, possibly worshippers or saints. The postcard is styled after old European religious prints, with decorative crowns and monograms in the corners.
